description: Use when you need a domain lookup, whois, dns records or certificate transparency data for osint, security or due diligence. Do not use for historical whois, registrant personal data (redacted by registries) or port and vulnerability scans. Returns JSON with domain intelligence: WHOIS/RDAP registration, DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA), SPF and DMARC, and TLS certificates from certificate transparency logs for 0.02 USDC per call. Typical response time 4000 ms (p95). Category: Data.

certificates.description: Include issued TLS certificates from Certificate Transparency (crt.sh); true when omitted

domain.description: Domain name in ASCII (punycode for internationalized names), e.g. example.com

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON
